items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: I had absolutely nothing to do with Jack Benny and Mary Livingston's

ctx.x: So Schiffman sent for me, and I went down and I told him, I said, "Well under no circumstances will I appear." I said, "Because our understanding was that this would never happen."

And, of course, then he went on to tell me about how Jack Benny and Mary Livingston worked together and they hadn't spoken for years. And, of course, I had to tell him I had absolutely nothing to do with Jack Benny and Mary Livingston's
